title: GumiExpressiveMode
description: Configuration and live stats for a single Gumi expressive mode channel.

channel.description: Which expressive channel this config applies to.

mode.description: Current delivery mode for this channel.

max_per_day.description: Maximum deliveries allowed per calendar day.

max_per_week.description: Maximum deliveries allowed per calendar week.

start.description: HH:MM start of quiet window (subject local time).

end.description: HH:MM end of quiet window (subject local time).

last_generated.description: ISO 8601 datetime of last generation attempt.

last_delivered.description: ISO 8601 datetime of last successful delivery.

reply_rate.description: Fraction of deliveries the subject replied to (0.0–1.0).

dismissal_rate.description: Fraction of deliveries the subject dismissed (0.0–1.0).

overreach_flags.description: List of overreach event labels logged for this channel.

risk_level.description: Current assessed risk level for this channel.
